name: gmor45-bootstrap
description: A single pointer skill that loads Gmor45's operating rules from their private repo at session start. Public so it can be synced; carries no rules of its own.

plugins.description: Fetches the operating rules from the private claude-audit repo at the start of any session, and installs a Stop hook that refuses to end a substantive turn without a plain-English closing block (What I did / Why / Recommendations / TLDR). Contains no rules itself.
